Derived from the fixture designs (PHASE4_4A_FIXTURE_PLAN.md, PHASE4_4C_PLAN.md §3-5, PHASE4_4D_PLAN.md §4) and confirmed against the live stores 2026-07-03. last_touch.note_y: visitorY is the load-bearing per-field null-skip case: source/medium credited from touch1, ai_source from touch3 — DIFFERENT touchpoints, matching HogQL's per-column argMax semantics. visitorZ is the exact-timestamp tie: both stores agreed (google/cpc) at capture; a future disagreement is reported as documented ambiguity, not parity failure (4C §5).

ai_platforms.note: P pins AI-not-last-touch (backward scan past google/cpc). R pins most-recent-AI-wins (Perplexity, not ChatGPT) past a trailing direct touch. S is the negative case — must be PRESENT with null credit on both legs.
